rationale: In this fresh direct review, the pinned source page and all D001-D099 dependencies show exact agreement on the positive-scale corollary. The target's nonempty finite type gives a positive cardinal N; its summand coefficient (card ι : Real)⁻¹ is 1/N; K is the full-family maximum finite psi-one gauge; the event is the absolute normalized sum; and the right side is exactly 2 exp(-cN min(t²/K²,t/K)) with one uniform positive c. Measurability, integrability, and the common probability measure make explicit the source's random-variable, expectation, and sub-exponential setting. The only semantic difference is deliberate: where the source leaves K=0 division undefined, the target states the correct endpoint tail bounds. Thus Lean implies the source on its ordinary effective domain, while the source does not imply the extra K=0 branch; the result is accepted as faithful-stronger without unresolved evidence requiring adjudication.
